title: A client form can skip approval
description: Turn off Needs approval in a client form's settings and it only collects answers — for a feedback form, say. Nothing goes to a team leader and no task is made.
items: Answers are read on the form's Responses tab
The client's confirmation says it was received, without promising a review
Urgency and the client approval window are hidden on such a form
pending: Needs the P16 database updates applied before it works.
